Introduction

Mirani is a South Korean rapper under AT AREA. She was a contestant on Show Me The Money 9 in 2020 and got eliminated in Round 7 after going against Lil Boi.

She made her solo debut independently with the digital single "The Detective" on April 24, 2020. She is also a member of the project girl group TDYA.
